title: SETTINGS PANE BACK TO ONE SHAPE
why: Job 113: nine settings checks went red because v34.51 to v34.53 gave the detail pane a hero value and a packed shape that older rulings and checks forbid. The pane is back to full height without the repeated value; a jump chip never scrolls the list; one raw hex colour became a named colour.
now: The settings side pane is back to its full height and no longer repeats the row value.

edits.anchor: #root #settingsmodal #setwrap > #setdetail:not(.daily-restore-detail) .sdv{ display:block; flex:1 1 100%; margin:var(--sp-2) 0 0; padding:0; border:0; font:800 var(--fs-hero)/1.1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--acc); overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
edits.replacement: /* v34.54 (cw-setrevert) job 113: the detail pane hero value and the packed pane (v34.51 to v34.53) are out again. Reason: the older rulings and checks 30.05, 31.75 and 33.28 say the pane never repeats the row value (the row shows it) and runs the full list height; the critic scored the two shapes against each other with no gain (92 stayed 3). */

edits.anchor: #root #settingsmodal #setwrap > #setdetail:not(.daily-restore-detail) .sdv.on{ color:var(--acc); }   /* v34.53 (cw-playdata3) job 113, critic round 3 on 92: the live value is lime only when it is on; the restore warning is body size (the critic read it as 12px) */
scroll-padding-top:64px; -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 calc(100% - 48px),transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 calc(100% - 48px),transparent); }
edits.replacement: scroll-padding-top:64px; -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black calc(100% - 48px),transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black calc(100% - 48px),transparent); }

try{ if(!(el.closest&&el.closest('.setjump'))) el.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'}); }catch(_e){}   // v34.54 (cw-setrevert): the jump chips are sticky, so focusing one never moves the list
